name: OpenVibe.Rent

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are rows in the database, so a person stays signed in across the restart
the expiry sweep marks listings whose 30 days passed during the stop (search filters on expires_at anyway)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0002 only create Rent's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 5010, unit openvibe-rent.service. Listings people post themselves (apartments, rooms, houses, commercial space, parking and storage, equipment): no scraped or partner sources until their terms are verified, no payments, deposits or messaging. Street addresses are refused; the contact link is shown only to signed-in people; three distinct reports hide a listing until staff (Network role claim) look; listings expire after 30 days and can be renewed. Search with facets and saved searches. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client rent, JWKS). Owns rent_listings, rent_reports, rent_saved_searches.

site.name: Rent
site.tagline: Find a place, or rent yours out
site.what: Apartments, rooms, houses, workspace, parking and equipment for rent, posted by people, with safety rules and no payments taken.
